rules.message: UniFi network or VLAN has an invalid or missing CIDR
rules.recommendation: Enter a valid IPv4 CIDR and confirm that it matches the intended UniFi virtual network plan.

rules.message: UniFi VLAN falls outside its parent network
rules.recommendation: Move the VLAN into the parent address range or correct the parent network CIDR.

rules.message: UniFi network ranges overlap or duplicate one another
rules.recommendation: Assign unique non-overlapping CIDRs to each routed network and VLAN.

rules.message: UniFi VLAN has incomplete routing or isolation facts
rules.recommendation: Document the VLAN classification and routing or isolation policy.

rules.message: Internet path has no modeled UniFi gateway or firewall
rules.recommendation: Add a UniFi gateway or another firewall boundary to the WAN path and document the enforced policy.

rules.message: UniFi controller or equivalent network telemetry is not modeled
rules.recommendation: Add the UniFi controller or another telemetry component and document log retention and review ownership.

rules.message: Critical UniFi infrastructure is modeled in one location
rules.recommendation: Distribute critical gateway, switching, management, or recording functions across independent locations where uptime requires it.

rules.message: Critical UniFi gateway has no redundancy fact
rules.recommendation: Model a supported gateway failover design or document the accepted single-gateway recovery plan.

rules.message: UniFi device has no modeled relationship
rules.recommendation: Connect the device to its gateway, switch, controller, recorder, or managed endpoint path.

rules.message: Critical UniFi device has no monitoring fact
rules.recommendation: Enable and document monitoring, alerting, ownership, and escalation for the critical device.

rules.message: Critical UniFi controller or recorder has no backup fact
rules.recommendation: Document configuration backup or video recovery requirements for the stateful UniFi component.

rules.message: UniFi network relationship lacks operational detail
rules.recommendation: Add a relationship label and document protocol or capacity where it affects design interpretation.
